description.value: Cold Shoulder Cafe is a small family-run cafe and bakery in Jordan River on the south end of Vancouver Island, founded in 2014 and now operated by one of the original founders and his family. Situated on West Coast Road near surf breaks and provincial parks, it serves soups, sandwiches, and pastries and also sells branded merchandise online and in-store. It sits on the challenging but scenic cycling route between Sooke and Port Renfrew, making it a natural rest stop for touring cyclists on this stretch of coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website provides strong direct evidence for several fields: the FAQ explicitly states no public bathrooms on-site and names Jordan River Campground as the nearest facility; the FAQ also confirms Wi-Fi for paying customers and GF/vegan options. Phone (250.646.2181) and address (11950 West Coast Rd) on the website match the OSM tags. The /menu subpage is clearly an unfilled Wix placeholder template with items named 'This Is Your First Item' etc., so no meaningful structured menu data can be drawn from it; actual food offerings (soups, sandwiches, pastries) are described elsewhere on the site.
concerns: The /menu subpage is an unfilled Wix template with placeholder item names ('This Is Your First Item', 'This Is Your Second Item', etc.) rather than an actual current menu; this may indicate the site is partially unmaintained, though the FAQ and front page content appear current.
The website states hours may vary as it is a family-run business and advises checking their Instagram for closures; cyclists making a dedicated detour should verify the cafe is open before arrival.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating family cafe at a confirmed address on a popular cycling route along Vancouver Island's south coast; website is active and current.

Washrooms.detail: FAQ explicitly states 'There are NO PUBLIC BATHROOMS at the cafe.' Nearest facilities noted as Jordan River Campground, approximately a 1-minute drive away, and major provincial/federal parks including China Beach, Sandcut Beach, and French Beach

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states 'We have a few GF and Vegan options. Soups and pastries change daily, so be sure to ask at the till.' Cross-contamination caveat noted for severe allergies
